Product Manager - B2B SaaS
BrowserStack
Gurugram, Haryana, India (Hybrid)

About BrowserStack:
BrowserStack is the world's leading software testing platform powered by cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities:
• Own the product strategy and roadmap for enterprise testing integrations.
• Author PRDs, customer journey maps, and technical documentation for developer tools.
• Conduct customer discovery interviews with enterprise engineering leaders across the globe.
• Drive GTM, pricing, and adoption in partnership with product marketing and enterprise sales.

Requirements:
• 3 to 5 years of experience in product management with focused experience in B2B SaaS or developer tools.
• Proven track record of delivering developer-centric or enterprise software products.
• Technical background with B.Tech / B.E. degree.
• Strong analytical mindset and cross-functional leadership.
